en.LEONARD_POINT_GUIDE_STEP_1: All Rangers have Leonard Points. \nCheck their details to see how many!\nBut, you ask, what are Leonard Points good for?
en.LEONARD_POINT_GUIDE_STEP_2:
There are two ways to Level Up a Ranger such that it will gain Leonard Points. 
The first is to combine it with a Super Leonard of the same grade. 
The second is to combine it with another of the same Ranger, 
in which case they don't need to be at the same grade.
en.LEONARD_POINT_GUIDE_STEP_3: Each Ranger's "Story" page shows the list of Rangers \nwhich you can combine it with in order to increase its Leonard Points.\nAny Leonard Points a Ranger has will remain after evolving.
en.LEONARD_POINT_GUIDE_STEP_4: 8-Star and below Normal Rangers can have up to 10 Leonard Points,\nwhile Ultimate and Hyper Evolved Rangers, \nas well as 9-Star Rangers can have up to 100 Leonard Points.
en.LEONARD_POINT_GUIDE_STEP_5: Your team's Leonard Points is the total number of Leonard Points \nof all your Rangers on both your A and B teams. \nThe more Leonard Points you can get on your active team, the better!
en.LEONARD_POINT_GUIDE_STEP_6:
When you clear main, special, or advent stages you'll have a chance 
to get extra rewards. This is called a Leonard Bonus. 
The chance of receiving a bonus will go up based 
on your team's Leonard Points.

en.POTENTIAL_TIP_DESC:
Potential Levels are the total sum of all stats' Potentials.
Potential level caps are as follows.
500 + the number of Rangers in collection + the number of mastered Rangers
Level cap is %d.
en.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_1: Oh, well done! After years of research, I've found a way to bring out new abilities in Rangers!
en.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_2: I'm going to explain Potential to you now, so be sure to keep up!
en.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_3: You can use level up materials to raise Rangers' Potential Levels and stats along with them. When you raise their Potential Levels, their stats will go up too.
en.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_4: Tap the Level Up button to raise Potential Levels.
en.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_5: The more Rangers you have in your collection, the higher you can raise their Potential Levels, so try to get as many Rangers as you can!
en.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_6: You can get the Materials you need to raise Potential Levels on main stages. It would be a good idea to clear main stages regularly to have a regular supply of Materials.
en.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_7: When you tap the reset button and reset a Ranger's Potential Level, you'll get back the Materials you used.
en.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_8: Careful though, if you reset a Ranger's Potentials without using a Reset Potentials Item, you'll only get back some of the materials you originally used.

en.PROFILE_TYPE_AGI_DESC:
'Agility-type' Rangers use Critical Hit 
and have great Normal DEF 
and Dodge Chance. 
They can easily damage sturdy 
Strength-type Rangers.
en.PROFILE_TYPE_INT_DESC:
'Intelligence-type' Rangers usually 
launch ranged attacks.
Because they have Magic ATK, 
they can easily handle Agility-type 
Rangers without Magic DEF.
en.PROFILE_TYPE_STR_DESC:
'Strength-type' Rangers have 
high HP, and also have Magic DEF 
and Skill Resistance. 
They are good at fighting 
Intelligence-type Rangers who 
mainly launch magic attacks.

en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_1: You can collect dice in missions.
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_10: Also, there are mystery “?” spaces; you never know which effect will be triggered.
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_11: Lastly, there are bonus chances where, you can get a chance to roll the dice again if you're lucky. Try your luck!
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_12: You can also get additional rewards based on your progress.
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_13: During the event, roll the dice to get better and greater rewards!
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_2: Roll the dice and get various rewards on the board.
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_3: The board is set with not only reward spaces, but there are special spaces too.
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_4: There are all kinds of special spaces: double rewards, move N spaces, map move, and even space travel!
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_5: First, the double reward spaces let you get twice the rewards for the space you land on.
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_6: When you land on a move N spaces space, you move forward or backward the number indicated on that space.
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_7: When you land on a map move space, you are randomly moved to a map with better rewards.
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_8: You'll return to the original map after completing 1 lap on the map with higher reward grades.
en.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_9: When you land on a space travel space, you can move to any reward space, excluding special tiles, of your choice and claim the rewards for that space.

en.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_TREE_UP: Wood Element Rangers have increased HP on this stage.\nUse as many Wood Element Rangers\nas you can here!
en.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_WATER_DOWN: Water Element Rangers have slightly reduced HP on this stage.\nTry to use as many non-Water Element Rangers\nas you can here!
en.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_WATER_UP: Water Element Rangers have increased HP on this stage.\nUse as many Water Element Rangers\nas you can here!
en.SPACE_TRAIN_DIFFICULY_DESC: The higher the difficulty, the more points you\n can get for the moving the same distance.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_END_NO_MORE_RANGERS: There are no Rangers available to participate.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_END_REACHED_FINISH: You have traveled to the end of the train.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_INFO: You can get higher scores by progressing farther while collecting Star Boxes.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_1: Space Trains are runner style Battle Stages where you play by switching to Rangers suited to the current lane you're running on.\n\nA Ranger's HP is determined by their combat power, which is set by replacing their stats.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_2: Colliding with Star Boxes grants you points along with various rewards.\n\nYour Fever Gauge gets a certain chance of filling up from Star Boxes. When the Fever Gauge is full, Fever Time activates, making Rangers grow larger and power up for a while.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_3: You'll take damage if you collide with enemies. However, colliding with enemies whose elements are compatible with your Ranger can reduce the damage taken.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_4: You’ll take significant damage if you collide with obstacles, so be sure to avoid them.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_5: If a buff pad's element matches the element of the Ranger stepping on it, that Ranger will power up for a while.\nWhen you get an item, it goes into effect immediately.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_EXCEED_ENTRY_ADMISSION: You have used up all the\nremaining entry attempts for today.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_NONE_PLAY: No players have played Space Train yet.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_NOT_ENOUGH_TIKET: You don't have enough Train Tickets!
en.SPACE_TRAIN_NO_STAGE_PLAY: You haven't played Train%d yet.\nPlay Space Train and bring peace back to the stations!
en.SPACE_TRAIN_PLAY_REWARD_INFO: Rewards appear randomly in Star Boxes, and their quantity varies by difficulty.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_POINT_TIP_DESC: Point totals are calculated by adding each Train's highest score.\nYour current rank is determined based on your total points.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_RANKING_NOT_PLAYED: No Space Train play history available.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_RENT_TIP_DESC: A Rental Ranger is a Ranger that can be used unlimited times during one stage only.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_STARTING_TIP_DESC: You can select and assign one Ranger as the starting member, deploying them at the start without using minerals. Other Rangers will appear randomly and can be swapped based on the player's selection.
en.SPACE_TRAIN_STORY_01: The Space Station, a symbol of peace\nconnecting many planets and civilizations,\nhas been invaded by unknown aliens!
en.SPACE_TRAIN_STORY_02: To save the Space Station in crisis,\nhop aboard Space Trains, defeat the aliens,\nand rescue the station from evil's darkness!
en.SPECIAL_CLEAR_POPUP_DESC: Collect Evolution Materials to level up the Rangers!
en.SPECIAL_ENTRY_ADMISSION_NO_ACCEPT: You have reached the daily entering limit for the day.
en.SPECIAL_ENTRY_GET_ITEM_DESC: You can earn this reward in this stage.
en.SPECIAL_LOSE_POPUP_DESC: Take the middle tower first to turn over the battle flow in special stages!
en.SPECIAL_QUEST_COMPLETE_DESC: Come back tomorrow for the next quest!
en.SPECIAL_QUEST_GIFT_COMPLETE_DESC: Good job completing all the quests!\nAre you ready to dispatch your Rangers?
en.SPECIAL_QUEST_SPECIAL_REWARD_RECIEVED_DE: You have received a special gift.

* Special quests consist of 7 unique challenges.
* You can clear one quest daily to get a variety of rewards.
* Complete all the 7 quests, and you'll get a special reward!
* Get your rewards before they disappear!
en.SPECIAL_QUEST_TIP_COMEBACk_DESC:
* Special quests consist of 7 unique challenges.
* You can clear one quest daily to get a variety of rewards.
* Complete all the 7 quests, and you'll get a special reward!
* Get your rewards before they disappear!

en.SPECIAL_STAGE_STORY_02: Use them to unleash your\nRangers' true powers!
en.SPECIAL_STAGE_STORY_03: Collect evolution materials in Special Stages, and\nmake Rangers more powerful through evolution!

There are a variety of special towers
in special stage battles.
Take over all of the special towers
to attack the enemy tower!
en.SPECIAL_STAGE_TUTORIAL_TXT2:
The special towers will help you if you
take them. Take over the special towers
before they are taken by the enemy!
Now, let's start!

en.STARWISH_LAYER_NOTICE_NO_ITEM_2: Get lots of Hammers in the next event and break Shooting Stars.

Collect Wish Hammers before
the meteor shower!

You can see Wish
details here.
en.STAR_WISH_HM_TUTORIAL_STEP_4: After the collection period for Hammers ends, the period for getting rewards will start. You can check the event schedule here.
en.STAR_WISH_HM_TUTORIAL_STEP_5:
Wish on a Shooting Star and
win good fortune for yourself!
en.STAR_WISH_TUTORIAL_STEP_1:
I finally found a Shooting Star
on the beach!
en.STAR_WISH_TUTORIAL_STEP_2:

is based on how many Wish Hammers we've collected.

Rangers or with another Ranger at the same
stage of evolution.

en.TEAM_BATTLE_FAIL_DESC: Equip your Rangers with gear to improve their STATS!

Cannot open because the waiting
time exceeded the end time.
\nStay tuned for the next event!

After clearing a mission, tap the get button to open an additional Token Box.
- Box openings in missions are not included in the cumulative count.

The times left until you
can get the Ranger/Gear
Chests will be converted

<#ffe53d>Transfer Complete<->\nData transfer successful.
Returning to the title screen
to log in again.
en.TRANS_INSTRUCTION_DESC:
Here is how to transfer your data.
To configure a transfer, select Data Transfer Settings.
For guest accounts, data transfers are available for 24 hours after transfer settings have been set.
Transferring data via this feature is only possible between iOS devices.
Please also consider using the "Login with LINE" feature, as linking your LINE account will allow you to conveniently transfer your data simply by logging in.
en.TRANS_SETTING_DESC_1:
Your ID and password will be used to transfer your data.
Transfer ID: Set an ID of your choice
(5 to 10 alphanumeric characters only. Case-sensitive.)
Password: Issued after ID registration
Notes:
- Data transfer is only possible between iOS devices.
- After transferring your data, the guest account data on the original device will be deleted.
en.TRANS_SETTING_DESC_2:
Notes:
- We will be unable to provide support for any issues that occur during the transfer process. Please save your ID and password in a safe place.
- Your password is valid for 24 hours after registration, and you have a maximum of 10 attempts to enter your password.
- After transferring your data, the guest account data on the original device will be deleted.
en.TREASURE_CHEST_BOTTOM_DESC_MSG3: The item opens when you collect all three treasures.
en.TREASURE_TIP_DESC: Collect all the 3-Star treasures to gain a 100% item buff effect!
en.TUTORIAL_02_ALLY_TOWER_TIP_DESC: This is your side's Tower. Be careful! Don't let its HP reach 0, or you'll lose the battle.
en.TUTORIAL_02_ENEMY_TOWER_DESC: This is the enemy's Tower. Your goal is to destroy it.
en.TUTORIAL_02_ENEMY_TOWER_TIP_DESC: This is the enemy's Tower. Your goal is to destroy it.
en.TUTORIAL_02_LEONARD_SPEECH: Well then, shall we start up for real, albeit slowly?
en.TUTORIAL_02_MINERAL_GAUGE_TIP_DESC: Don't forget that Mineral is at the core of everything you do in battle.
en.TUTORIAL_02_MINERAL_UPGRADE_TIP_DESC: Tap this button if you want to increase your Mineral total.
en.TUTORIAL_02_MISSILE_TIP_DESC: If the battle's not going well for you, you can call on the power of your Tower.
en.TUTORIAL_02_RANGER_TIP_DESC: These are the Rangers who'll fight for you. You can deploy them by using some Mineral.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP01_TXT: This is our Tower. We'll lose if its HP reaches 0, so be careful!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP02_TXT: This is the enemies' Tower. Our goal is to destroy it and win!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP03_TXT: These are Rangers who will deploy into the battle. You need Mineral to deploy them.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP05_TXT: Our Mineral decreased a lot, but Mineral gradually increases with the passage of time.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP06_TXT: Upgrading will let you get Mineral faster and store more of it.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP07_TXT: Of course, it's not free. Upgrades cost Mineral too.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP08_TXT: Moon! The missile finished charging. Fire it!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP09_TXT: You can speed up missile charging by tapping the Missile button repeatedly.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP_C1_TXT: Moon, you've got lots of Mineral. Deploy more Rangers!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP01_TXT: (Huh? Where am I? I know I was walking with Sally...)
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP02_TXT: Moon! What are you doing! The space army is gathering!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP03_TXT: Cony? Jessica? What's going on? Where's Sally?
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP04_TXT: What are you talking about, Moon? Our Tower's gonna break! Get it together!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP05_TXT: That's Moon for you, always muttering nonsense. Cony, we'd better explain things to him again.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP06_TXT: Are you kidding me? Moon! I'll tell you one last time, so listen up!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP07_TXT: I'm amazed that you made it this far. But it's time we put an end to this. I'll take you on myself!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP08_TXT: Moon! Cony! We're in trouble! Mephisto himself appeared!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP09_TXT: Don't worry! If I remember everything you've taught me, I'll be able to handle him! Just trust me!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP10_TXT: (Now, let's take out Mephisto using what we learned from Cony)
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP11_TXT: Such pests. But that won't be enough. I'll show you my ambition of taking over the universe!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP13_TXT: Ah! It's no good. Everything's fading to black... Cony, Jessica, is this it for me? Everybody...
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP14_TXT: Guys! Oh, it was just a dream. It feels so real. It's like I really fought.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP15_TXT: Oh yeah. I was walking with Sally, right?
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP16_TXT: Sally! Sally! I had a dream that felt so real.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP17_TXT: Hahaha! It seems like you became a hero in your dream, eh Moon? I didn't think the special sleeping gas I created would work this well.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP18_TXT: Mephisto! No! But is it really Mephisto! No! Sally? Sally!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP19_TXT: I took Sally while you were catching up with your beauty sleep. Hahaha! I'll be going now! The universe belongs to me! Hahaha!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP20_TXT: No! I can't believe Mephisto kidnapped Sally! But this is no time to mope about. We have to go tell Dr. Leonard what happened!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP21_TXT: Arrrgh! Doctor Leonard! Something terrible's happened!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP22_TXT: Oh, it's you, Moon. Your face is as white as a sheet. Calm down and tell me in detail what happened.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP23_TXT: I was out walking with Sally when I suddenly had a daydream.
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP24_TXT: In my dream, I was a super strong Ranger. Everyone was jealous of me...
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP25_TXT: Alright, hold up a minute! I don't need that much detail! Just get to the "terrible" part!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP26_TXT: Uh, right... It's Sally... She... An army of Aliens kidnapped her!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP27_TXT: What?! That *is* terrible news! We have to go after her now!
en.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP28_TXT: Quickly, follow Mephisto to the next region!
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_GACHA0_STEP1_TXT: Come to think of it, we'll need lots of Rangers to rescue Sally.
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_GACHA0_STEP2_TXT: Hmm, perhaps we should take a look at the gacha screen.
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP10_TXT: Well... But... I... I'm sorry! If only I was a strong, super kick-butt hero...
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP11_TXT: Jessica, don't blame him. Moon did the best he could!
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP12_TXT: Alright, I guess what's done is done. Fine, I'll come with you.
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP13_TXT: Alright, stow the chatter, we've got a Sally to save! Go, go, go!
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP15_TXT: Now that Jessica joined, let's edit our team!
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP1_TXT: A new friend has joined the team.
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP6_TXT: Jessica, we need your help. Sally's been taken by an Alien army.
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP7_TXT: What do you mean, "Sally's been taken?"
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP8_TXT: When Sally and I were out walking, an Alien army appeared—
en.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP9_TXT: What?! And you just let them take her?!
en.TUTORIAL_ARENA_BATTLE_START:
This 30-on-30 brawl is about to start! 
Whose Rangers will see 
the end of battle? 
I have no idea, so let's find out!
en.TUTORIAL_AUTO_BATTLE_STEP1_TXT: There's a relaxed way to battle!
en.TUTORIAL_AUTO_BATTLE_STEP2_TXT: Toggle on AUTO with the button to use auto-battling.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP11_TXT: Well then, shall we start up for real, albeit slowly?
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP12_TXT: Let's try deploying some Rangers first.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP13_TXT: Hmm, we don't have enough resources. Maybe we should try a resource upgrade.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP14_TXT: OK, that should be enough. Now try selecting a Ranger that uses up a lot of resources.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP15_TXT: Missile charged! Now, fire it off!
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP16_TXT: You can speed up missile charging by tapping the Missile button repeatedly.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP17_TXT: OK, take out that enemy Tower!
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP18_TXT: Great job! Alright then, now let's go rescue Sally!
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP1_TXT: First, let me explain how battles work.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP2_TXT: This is your side's Tower. Don't let its HP reach 0, or you'll lose the battle.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP3_TXT: This is the enemy's Tower. Your goal is to destroy it.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP4_TXT: These are the Rangers who'll fight for you. You can deploy them by using some Mineral.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP5_TXT: Don't forget that Mineral is at the core of everything you do in battle.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP6_TXT: Tap this button if you want to increase your Mineral total.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP7_TXT: Of course in life, you get nothing for free. Upgrades will use up some of your Mineral total.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP8_TXT: If the battle's not going well for you, you can call on the power of your Tower.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE1_STEP1_TXT: Let's look for Sally in this next area.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE1_STEP2_TXT: Time to try equipping some items that'll help you in battle.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE_SALLYWEAPON: From now on, your third missile will be replaced\nwith a powerful Sally Missile!
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE_SPEED_STEP1_TXT: Once you've gotten used to battles, why not try battling faster?
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE_SPEED_STEP2_TXT: You can speed up battles with the speed button.
en.TUTORIAL_BATTLE_TEAMCHANGE: With this item, you can change your team during\nthe game. Strategically play by switching\nbetween team A and team B in the battle!
en.TUTORIAL_COMPLETE_STEP01_TXT:
OK, you got all the Adventure Data.
Let's make sure nothing's missing.
en.TUTORIAL_DAILY_FREE_PACKAGE_TXT: You can get free items every day from the Package Shop.
en.TUTORIAL_DOWN_STEP01_TXT: Wait a sec! Take this extra Adventure Data before you go!
en.TUTORIAL_DOWN_STEP03_TXT: It's an extra device for all of you to experience new adventures!
en.TUTORIAL_DOWN_STEP04_TXT: You just need to wait a little. Here, take it.
en.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP01_TXT: Oh, so you got a Dr. Leonard!
en.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP03_TXT: Well, Dr. Leonards are very helpful in raising the levels of your characters.
en.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP04_TXT: Doctor, how do I use them?
en.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP05_TXT: It's easy. All you have to do is combine the Ranger you want to grow with a Dr. Leonard.
en.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP07_TXT: What's the difference between this and the Ranger enhancing you told me about before?
en.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP08_TXT: You'll get more EXP than with normal enhancing, so you'll evolve faster.
en.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP09_TXT: Wow! That's great news! Thanks, Doctor!
en.TUTORIAL_DUPLICATED_UNIT_UPGRADE_1: The Ranger you won is \nthe same Ranger you already have!
en.TUTORIAL_DUPLICATED_UNIT_UPGRADE_2: When combining the same Rangers,\ntheir max level goes up,\nand you can unlock Talents too!
en.TUTORIAL_ELEMENT_UNLOCK_STEP1: Some existing Rangers \nthat did not have an elemental type \ncan now have one.
en.TUTORIAL_ELEMENT_UNLOCK_STEP2: Find Evolution Materials \nin Special Stages and use them \nto unlock Ranger Elements!
en.TUTORIAL_END_GEAR_TEXT: Wow! You drew great gear!\nTap the gear in the Ranger details \nwindow to equip your Rangers with it!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP10_TXT: Here's where you can get more Gear.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP112_TXT: You can have the first Gear item!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP113_TXT: Here you are! It's all yours!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP11_TXT: Really?! Thank you so much, Doc!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP12_TXT: Ho-ho! Nice Gear you've got there!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP13_TXT: With that said... How do we use these thingies?
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP14_TXT: Hmm, let me walk you through the basics... Choose which Ranger you want to equip your Gear with.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP15_TXT: Here, you can see what Gear your Team's currently got equipped. See how all your Gear slots are empty right now?
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP16_TXT: Yeah, I see. So we've been fighting barehanded up till now?
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP17_TXT: Yes, you could say that. So, equip the Gear that you just got.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP18_TXT: Tell me how to do that now, Doctor!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP19_TXT: Calm down and slow your roll! Now, choose an empty Gear slot.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP21_TXT: I'll go through it with you step-by-step, \nso don't worry. \nThis window shows you what you have equipped now.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP22_TXT: Each Ranger can equip a Weapon, an Armor, and an Accessory.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP23_TXT: And this over here is the list of Gear you guys own. Try equipping some of it now.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP24_TXT: Well done! Now that you've Geared up, you should be a bit stronger now.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP25_TXT: Okay, I think that's enough. Let's go!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP2_TXT: Oh-ho! What happened here? You're all covered in dirt!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP3_TXT: Hehe, this is what happened when we went off to rescue Sally.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP4_TXT: Hmm... well, you all did get ready and leave in a hurry!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP5_TXT: What do you mean by "get ready?"
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP6_TXT: Oh yes, come to think of it, it's about time you equipped yourselves with some new Gear.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP7_TXT: New Gear? Awesome! Brown looks super stoked too!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP9_TXT: Come on over to the gacha.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP10_TXT: First, you have to choose the Gear item you want to enhance. Choose a Ranger, and then choose a Gear slot.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP112_TXT: Alright! Tap the ENHANCE button in the Gear info window to enhance it.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP11_TXT: So, do you want to enhance the shield you just got?
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP12_TXT: You'll need to use some other Gear items as materials to enhance your chosen Gear item.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP13_TXT: So we have to use up materials here too, huh?
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP14_TXT: That's right. Choose some Gear from the list on the right to use as materials.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP15_TXT: Alright, your Gear's been enhanced. Don't forget that Gear that's enhanced like this not only has its basic abilities enhanced, but its Element as well.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP16_TXT: Wow, I wish I could enhance my Gear too!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP17_TXT: There's no need to get jealous, it's easy to come by the materials you need for Gear enhancements.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP18_TXT: Well then, shall we go to the next stage?
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP1_TXT: Hey Brown, what's that in your hand there?
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP3_TXT: Come on Brown, show it to me!
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP4_TXT: Oh, a new Gear item, eh? Considering the Gear you have now, this doesn't look like it would be very useful to you, though.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP5_TXT: Oh, I did think it was rather easy to get.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP6_TXT: Don't be so disappointed, Moon. Now's a good time to explain Gear enhancements to you.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP7_TXT: Gear enhancements? But we're already pretty well powered up...
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP8_TXT: You'll like this, it's a way to make your Gear even more powerful.
en.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP9_TXT: Wow, that sounds amazing! Tell us more!
en.TUTORIAL_EVOLVE_LIST_STEP1:
You can check the acquired evolution
materials here! Check evolution
materials required for each Ranger
in Ranger Info > Evolution menu!
en.TUTORIAL_EVOLVE_STEP1:
You can increase the current 
Ranger's grade!
But, it is only available for 
Master Ranger!
en.TUTORIAL_EVOLVE_STEP2:
You need materials acquired
in special stages to evolve Rangers!
Collect materials first, then
 Rangers are all set for evolution.
en.TUTORIAL_EVOLVE_STEP3: Press Preview to see \nthe appearance of the evolved Ranger!
en.TUTORIAL_EVOLVE_STEP4: Tap [Evolve] when all materials are collected!\nYour Ranger will become more powerful!
en.TUTORIAL_EVOLVE_SWITCH_STEP1:
You can change Rangers' 
evolutions here!
Switch evolutions as needed to 
make the perfect team!
en.TUTORIAL_EVOLVE_SWITCH_STEP2:
Certain evolution materials are needed 
to switch evolutions.
Don't worry; Level, Leonard Points, 
and Gear are kept when you switch!
Alright, let's give it a try!
en.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_AREA_1: The new Extreme difficulty level is now unlocked for a fresh challenge! Ready to take a quick look and see what it's all about?
en.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_AREA_2: You can clear each stage once a day. The maximum number of daily entries is shared with the existing Hard difficulty, so make sure to manage your attempts wisely!
en.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_AREA_3: Well then, shall we jump right in and \ncheck out a stage with the new difficulty?
en.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_ENTRY_1: Extreme difficulty stages come with different battle gimmicks unique to each stage. Checking them before heading into battle will definitely give you an edge. You can view the gimmicks here.
en.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_ENTRY_2: If you tap on a gimmick icon, you can check its detailed information. Try experimenting with different team compositions to match each gimmick!
en.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_START: We've picked up a new distress signal. \nShall we go ahead and check it out?
en.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP10_TXT: This is where you choose which friend will help you in battle. The friend you choose can only help you once a day.
en.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP11_TXT: Try choosing a friend now. That friend's Rangers will come to assist you in the next battle.
en.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP12_TXT: Alright, let's call on a friend's help now. Tap the friend button above.
en.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP14_TXT: Well done, everyone! Keep fighting the good fight against the Alien army with your friends!
en.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP2_TXT: What happened? Did Sally come home?
en.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP3_TXT: No, there's about as much chance of that as you growing a pink afro. The Alien army won't make things that easy, Moon!
en.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP6_TXT: Some friends have turned up who'll help you.
en.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP8_TXT: Let's have a look now. We'll see them in battle, so let's get into a fight!
en.TUTORIAL_FRIEND_STEP11_TXT: Alright, let's call on a friend's help now. Tap the friend button above.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP11_TXT: Oh my, well aren't you looking good? You still don't have anything on me, though.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP13_TXT: Jessica, we need your help. Sally's been taken by an Alien army.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP14_TXT: What do you mean, "Sally's been taken?"
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP15_TXT: When Sally and I were out walking, an Alien army appeared—
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP16_TXT: What?! And you just let them take her?!
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP17_TXT: Well... But... I... I'm sorry! If only I was a strong, super kick-butt hero...
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP18_TXT: Jessica, don't blame him. Moon did the best he could!
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP19_TXT: Alright, I guess what's done is done. Fine, I'll come with you.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP1_TXT: A new friend has joined the team.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP20_TXT: Alright, stow the chatter, we've got a Sally to save! Go, go, go!
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP22_TXT: Now that you have more Rangers, let's look at your Team again.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP23_TXT: Your Team has 5 Rangers in it. Swipe to arrange your Team or remove Rangers from your Team.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP24_TXT: Is there anything I should be careful of when putting my Team together?
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP25_TXT: Yes, there are some things you should keep in mind.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP26_TXT: Each Ranger has their own Element, of which there are 5: Water, Fire, Wood, Light, and Dark.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP27_TXT: Each element has their own connections to other Elements. Look at this chart to see how they interact with each other.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP28_TXT: Depending on a Ranger's Element, they'll deal extra damage to the right enemies, or in turn take more damage themselves.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP3_TXT: There's someone I would like to introduce you to.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP5_TXT: Hmm, perhaps we should take a look at the gacha screen.
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP6_TXT: You need Rubies to summon friends.\nUse the 20 Rubies you got from me to tap the button and call up a friend!
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP9_TXT: Oh, it was you guys who called me here?
en.TUTORIAL_GACHA_COMPLETE:
WOW!! That's some good-looking
Rangers you have there.
Let's go rescue Sally with other 
Rangers!
en.TUTORIAL_GO_TO_TEAM_SET: Let's learn about setting your team.
en.TUTORIAL_GUILD_RAID_START:
Attack Guardians with your guild
members within the time limit!
Defeat lots of Guardians to get
good rewards!
en.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_AREA: Watch out! This place is pretty creepy, huh?\nRight over there! Go ahead, tap!
en.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_ENTRY_1: You can get a special reward the first time you get a clear on Hard difficulty, so give it all you got!
en.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_ENTRY_2: Even if it's not your first clear, you can still get items you need to power up your Rangers, so be sure to play every day!
en.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_ENTRY_3: Hard mode stages can only be cleared once a day each. Try again tomorrow!
en.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_ENTRY_4: Too hard? Tap (?) for a handy tip!
en.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_PRESS_BTN: The S.O.S. is coming from over there.\nIt's a very dangerous place. Be careful.
en.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_START: We've received a call for help!\nDr. PAIMON's already been captured,\nso what could it be? Hurry!
en.TUTORIAL_HYPER_EVOLVE_STEP1:
Hyper Evolution is different than 
other evolutions 
in that you need Advent Rangers 
to achieve it.
en.TUTORIAL_HYPER_EVOLVE_STEP2:
Once you Hyper Evolve, 
you'll get a second Skill 
and a special Ability 
that only Hyper Rangers can possess.
en.TUTORIAL_HYPER_EVOLVE_STEP3: Make your Rangers stronger \nby Hyper Evolving them to get \nthese special Skills and Abilities!
en.TUTORIAL_HYPER_UNIT_UPGRADE_EXCEEDMAX_2: If you combine an Hyper Ranger\nwith Hyper Leonard,\nMax level will increase!
en.TUTORIAL_ITEM_AREA: We don't know where they took Sally. \nTry the 'Valley of Wind' first.
en.TUTORIAL_ITEM_ENTRY: Try using an item and getting help\nfrom a friend. Pick an item.
en.TUTORIAL_ITEM_ENTRY_FRIEND: Choose a friend.\nItems and friends you select will come \nto your aid during the game.
en.TUTORIAL_ITEM_MAIN:
Tutorial reward Rangers Underwear
Brown and Pink Ribbon Pico
are getting ready for battle!
Let's get down to business
and enter the main stages!
en.TUTORIAL_ITEM_USE_FRIEND: Get help by calling a friend's Ranger.
en.TUTORIAL_ITEM_USE_ITEM: Tap the item to use it.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP12_TXT: Well, you can't get better looking than I already am anyway.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP13_TXT: That's not actually what I meant...
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP14_TXT: Doctor, you don't have to respond to every pointless thing he says.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP15_TXT: Understood. So, let's talk about powering up again. Choose a new Ranger.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP17_TXT: In order to level up, you'll need to have some other Rangers. Choose which Rangers you want to use for combining.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP18_TXT: Alright then, tap the Level Up button and you'll do just that. Remember though, the Rangers you use for the combination will disappear!
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP19_TXT: Well, it *looks* like he's getting stronger...
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP20_TXT: I think his overall stats have gone up too!
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP21_TXT: Phew, thank goodness! Now we won't have any trouble no matter how powerful those Aliens are!
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP23_TXT: Alright, let's move on to the next stage.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP2_TXT: Uuuugh... Don't say any more about it. It looks like the Alien army's getting gradually stronger and stronger.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP3_TXT: Doctor, we need some new countermeasures. Got any ideas?
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP4_TXT: Oh, well that's easy. You guys just need to power up too.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP5_TXT: Ah, that's brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP6_TXT: Well that's because you don't know how.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP7_TXT: ...Doctor, could you be a bit more specific as to how we can do that?
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP8_TXT: There are several ways to power yourselves up. For now, I'll just teach you how to beef up your bodies by leveling up.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP9_TXT: Would there be any ways to beef up my beauty too?
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP10_TXT: Where was I? Ah yes, now I'll teach you how to raise your level caps.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP12_TXT: It's pretty similar to when you normally level up. You just have to select the same "twin" Rangers to combine as the Ranger you want to level up.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP13_TXT: Now, combine your twin, uh, I mean, your new Ranger.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP16_TXT: I'm not sure, but it feels like he's got even more potential now.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP17_TXT: Indeed, you've raised your level cap. This is how you can raise your maximum power levels.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP18_TXT: You have to work to make sure the Rangers who join you later don't overtake you!
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP1_TXT: Doctor, look at this. We got a new Ranger, but he looks like he could be my twin!
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP20_TXT: Exactly! It's vital that you keep that drive to keep becoming more powerful.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP21_TXT: You'll no doubt face new, unknown dangers out there. You must train your hardest to be ready for whatever they may be!
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP22_TXT: Let's roll out, with the wind flowing in our hair!
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP23_TXT: Okay, let's head to the next stage and look for Sally.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP3_TXT: Ho-ho, this is good timing. This time, I'll teach you all about raising your level caps.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP5_TXT: Well, you have limits to how far you can level up, and you can't go over those limits. Once you reach those limits, you can't get any stronger.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP6_TXT: Yeah, I thought so... I had a feeling that I reached my max.
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP7_TXT: Really? I don't think you've reached your maximum level yet...
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP8_TXT: Whoops, ah, yeah, heh-heh, I guess I haven't!
en.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP9_TXT: Moon, stop fidgeting! Doctor, please hurry up and continue.
en.TUTORIAL_NORMAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP1_TX: A new Auto-Advance feature has been added.
en.TUTORIAL_NORMAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP2_TX: The Auto-Advance feature automatically clears new stages for you.
en.TUTORIAL_NORMAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP3_TX: When using Auto-Advance you won't be able to use items or Friends features.
en.TUTORIAL_NORMAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP4_TX: Please note that Auto-Advance may stop if you run out of Feathers, fail, or due to some other conditions.
en.TUTORIAL_NORMAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP5_TX: The newly added features make it even more convenient to enjoy main stages!
en.TUTORIAL_PASS_STEP1_TXT: Get lots of extra rewards  \n with Rangers Passes!
en.TUTORIAL_PASS_STEP2_TXT: Get Rangers Pass Points and reach \n the required Pass Levels \n to get extra rewards!
en.TUTORIAL_PASS_STEP3_TXT: You can also get Tower Skins \n by activating a Rangers Pass \n and raising its level.
en.TUTORIAL_PASS_STEP4_TXT:
You can get
Bonus Random Chests
after reaching
the final level.
en.TUTORIAL_PASS_STEP5_TXT: You can get Rangers Pass Points\nby clearing Daily, Weekly,\nand Special Missions.
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_10:
Every time you use Rubies and
Gacha Tickets and play gachas,
you'll get Mileage Points!
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_11:
Use Mileage Points to
get various rewards
like Gacha Tickets.
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_12:
Get stronger Rangers
and Gear items!
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_2: Use Rubies and Gacha Tickets to get Rangers and become even stronger!
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_3:
In the case of Rangers,
whenever you play the Ultra
Rare and Selection Gachas
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_4: the ceiling gauge will go up.
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_5: Want to learn about the Gear Gacha?
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_6: Gear items can only be obtained with Rubies,
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_7:
and you can fill up the Gear gauge
by playing the Special Gear Gacha!
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_8:
You can get rewards when the
gauge reaches different levels.
en.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_9:
You can see a list of the
rewards you can get here!
en.TUTORIAL_PVP_ELEMENTAL_STEP1_TXT: There have been some new changes in PVP.\nIt looks like PVP will have new rules this season!\nPowerful elemental effects are occurring throughout the stages.
en.TUTORIAL_PVP_ELEMENTAL_STEP2_TXT: Rangers of the same element as the target area will receive a significant buff,\nwhile those with different elements will get a debuff.\nBe careful when you make your teams!
en.TUTORIAL_PVP_ELEMENTAL_STEP3_TXT: Tap the "?" icon for details.\nDon't forget that elements are crucial this time.\nSee you later!
en.TUTORIAL_PVP_ELEMENTAL_STEP4_TXT: Aim for the top of this season's rankings!
en.TUTORIAL_PVP_GUARDIAN_SELECT_GUIDE: A guild guardian will help you \nin PVP! \nMake a choice and go for it!
en.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLECLEAR_1: A play again feature has been added!\nYou can now play the same stage again\nright after you've cleared it.
en.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLECLEAR_2: You can also move to the next stage\nfaster than usual\nby using the new shortcut feature!
en.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLE_ENTRY_1: Now you can use the repeat play and multiplier play features!
en.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLE_ENTRY_2: Choose the number of times you want to play with the repeat play feature and you'll be able to repeat battles as much as you like.
en.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLE_ENTRY_3: Use lots of Feathers at once with the multiplier feature to get rewards based on how many you used!
en.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLE_ENTRY_4: Please note that you can't use items, friend features, or continue on battles with the multiplier play feature.
en.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLE_ENTRY_5: The newly added features make it even more convenient to enjoy main stages!
en.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_0_STEP01: I see you've been putting in a good effort. I have new missions for you today.
en.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_0_STEP03: Yes, but you are full-fledged adventurers so you will be fine.
en.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_0_STEP05: Ha! Don't worry. You will be properly compensated for taking on this new responsibility.
en.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_0_STEP07: Tap the 7 Days icon over on the right side.
en.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_1_STEP01: You can see your missions here.
en.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_1_STEP02: You can handle these missions at your current level, so don't worry.
en.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_1_STEP03: You can see details by tapping the help button. Do your best!
en.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_BATTLE_STEP1_TXT: You can alternate between using two lanes on Space Trains.
en.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_BATTLE_STEP2_TXT: Try changing the lane your Ranger runs on by tapping the other lane or the screen.
en.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_BATTLE_STEP3_TXT: You can also swap the running Ranger with a waiting Ranger. Aim for higher scores by making appropriate swaps based on the situation!
en.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_MAIN_STEP1_TXT: Wait! An SOS signal is coming from across the universe! Should we check it out?
en.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_STEP2_TXT: To save the Space Station, you must hop aboard various Space Trains and defeat the enemy while avoiding obstacles!
en.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_STEP3_TXT: You can play stages using Train Tickets. Train Tickets recharge regularly after a certain amount of time, so check back often!
en.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_STEP4_TXT: Play Space Train to collect points for stage rewards in order to unlock stages!
en.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_STEP5_TXT: Compete with other players using the highest scores you’ve got on each stage!
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP10_TXT: Well, no, they're not those kind of rewards, James.
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP11_TXT: Doctor, you can just ignore James.
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP12_TXT: Ah, then I shall. Let's check the Missions and roll out!
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP1_TXT: Hey everyone, over here. I've got something to show you.
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP3_TXT: I've got some new Missions for novice adventurers like yourselves.
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP4_TXT: Well we kinda have our hands full just looking for Sally right now...
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP5_TXT: Oh, it's nothing to worry about. You'll be glad you took on these tasks!
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP6_TXT: What kind of things do we have to do?
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP7_TXT: See this? Here's where I put all the Missions I have for you. When you fulfill the conditions for that Mission, it will be immediately counted as complete.
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP8_TXT: And naturally, I'll give you rewards for every job you complete. You'll find my rewards very useful when it comes to powering yourselves up...
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP9_TXT: Oh, so I can take my good looks to even greater heights...
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP1_T: A new Auto-Advance feature has been added.
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP2_T: The Auto-Advance feature lets you automatically keep on battling on this planet’s stages.
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP3_T: When using Auto-Advance you won't be able to use items or Friends features.
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP4_T: With the Auto-Advance feature turned on, you’ll advance to the next step after a 3-second countdown and continue automatically until the final Boss Stage.
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP5_T: Please note that Auto-Advance may stop if you run out of Feathers, fail, or due to some other conditions.
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_UNIT_UPGRADE_EXCEEDMAX_: If you combine a Ranger with Super Leonard, \nMax level will increase!
en.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_UNIT_UPGRADE_EXP_2: If you combine a Ranger with Dr. Leonard, \nEXP will increase!
en.TUTORIAL_START_AREA: This is your proving ground to see \nif you're up to the task of saving Sally. \nTest your skills?
en.TUTORIAL_START_END:
Nice job! You've still got a ways to go,
but it looks like you're ready to go out
and save Sally for real! Here's
Underwear Brown and Pink Ribbon Pico
for all of your hard work!
en.TUTORIAL_START_GEAR_TEXT: Did you know that gear can make \nyour Rangers more powerful?\nTry getting an gear from the Gacha?
en.TUTORIAL_START_HOME: Please help!!\nThe alien troops took Sally away!\nFind Sally with the Rangers!
en.TUTORIAL_START_MINERAL: Increasing your mineral level boosts your\n maximum production quantity and speed.\nLet's level it up now!
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP10_TXT: Um... Ya know, I hadn't really thought that far ahead yet.
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP11_TXT: Then don't worry, I'll teach you, bit by bit.
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP12_TXT: Come on, to the training room!
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP13_TXT: Come on, to the training room!
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP1_TXT: Arrrgh! Doctor Leonard! Something terrible's happened!
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP2_TXT: Oh, it's you, Moon. Your face is as white as a sheet. Calm down and tell me in detail what happened.
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP3_TXT: Well, I was out walking with Sally, and I slowed my pace down to match Sally's because she has such stubby little legs...
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP4_TXT: There was a nice breeze, and we were humming along and...
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP5_TXT: Alright, hold up a minute! I don't need that much detail! Just get to the "terrible" part!
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP6_TXT: Uh, right... It's Sally... She... An army of Aliens kidnapped her!
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP7_TXT: What?! That *is* terrible news! We have to go after her now!
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP8_TXT: Yes, Doc! I'll go after her right now!
en.TUTORIAL_START_STEP9_TXT: Wait a minute there! How are you going to fight the Alien army?
en.TUTORIAL_START_UNIT1: Collapse the enemy's tower located\non the right side to win.\nUse minerals to dispatch the Rangers.
en.TUTORIAL_START_UNIT2: Are you ready?\nDispatch your Ranger to attack\nthe enemy's tower.
en.TUTORIAL_START_WEAPON: When the missile gauge fills up\nyou can shoot missiles to attack.
en.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP01_TXT: So, you got a Super Leonard then.
en.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP03_TXT: Do you remember how to raise yourselves to maximum level?
en.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP04_TXT: We combine the same Rangers together?
en.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP05_TXT: Exactly! But Super Leonards like this can raise the maximum level of *other* Rangers.
en.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP06_TXT: Wow! If we don't need to be the same Ranger to use them, I'd like to use this one first!
en.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP07_TXT: Calm down, you'll get more Super Leonards in your coming adventures!
en.TUTORIAL_TALENT_RANGERS_2: You can unlock Talents <#ffe53d>1 level at a time<-> by combining the <#ffe53d>same Rangers<->, <#ffe53d>Rangers at the same stage of evolution<->, or <#ffe53d>Talent Leonards<->.
en.TUTORIAL_TALENT_RANGERS_3:
There are 2 types of unlockable Talents.
There are <#ffe53d>main Talents<-> that give <#ffe53d>special powers<->, and <#ffe53d>enhance Talents<-> that <#ffe53d>raise stats.<->
en.TUTORIAL_TALENT_RANGERS_4: In particular, main Talents will reveal very powerful effects at Level 1.
en.TUTORIAL_TALENT_RANGERS_5: Unlocked Talents are displayed like this. Nothing will display if no Talents have been unlocked, or there are no Talents.
en.TUTORIAL_TALENT_RANGERS_6: Each Ranger can have their own unique Talent effects, so be sure to check their Talents out!
en.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET0_STEP15_TXT: Alright! Now my Team's perfect! I ain't afraid of no stinky Alien force now!
en.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET0_STEP16_TXT: Then let's head out and rescue Sally.
en.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET0_STEP17_TXT: Yeah! Let's roll out, with the wind flowing through our hair!
en.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET0_STEP19_TXT: Hm? You got something else you wanted to say?
en.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET0_STEP20_TXT: Not really, it's just that... "Our" hair? You don't have any!
en.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET1_STEP1_TXT: So is there one Element that's stronger and one that's weaker than all the others?
en.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET1_STEP2_TXT: No, it really depends on the relationship between your Elements and the Elements of your opponents.
en.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET1_STEP3_TXT: Fire's weak to Water, but strong against Wood. Quite the expert, aren't you, James?
en.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET1_STEP4_TXT: Ah-hem! That's because my knowledge rivals only how handsome I am...
en.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET1_STEP6_TXT: Well then, let's add your new Rangers to your Team.
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_ADD: Good job!\nNow add a Ranger to the team.
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_FINISH: Making a team is easy!\nCreate a powerful team with\nyour selected  Ranger.

en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT3: Hm? You got something else you wanted to say?
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT5: Not really, it's just that... "Our" hair? You don't have any!
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT_2: Your Team has 5 Rangers in it.
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT_3: Swipe to arrange your Team or remove Rangers from your Team.
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT_4: First, take a Ranger on your team and drag to remove it.
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT_5: Good! Now drag a Ranger to add it to the team.
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SHIFT: You can switch a Ranger's place within a team.\nTry moving the Ranger's position.
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SLOT_SETTING:
Team slot added!
Build your team in various ways!
The team selected last will be saved
as your main team.
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SLOT_SETTING_2: Set up Team A and Team B \nto use both teams in the battle!
en.TUTORIAL_TEAM_TOWER_SKIN:
Change your Tower Skins here!
Get Tower Skins and 
apply them to your Tower!
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP10_TXT: Why don't we hear more about them while we look them over? Let's go to the treasure chests now.
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP11_TXT: There's a treasure chest over there. Let's go check it out!
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP13_TXT: This place holds the power of the ancients. Here, you can gain powers that will help you rescue Sally.
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP14_TXT: Alright! With these powers, we can rescue Sally in no time!
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP15_TXT: With that said... How do we use these powers?
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP16_TXT: You can't, not yet anyway. They're sealed away, and you'll have to break those seals.
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP17_TXT: So how do we do that?
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP18_TXT: You'll need to collect 3 treasures to break a seal. The treasure you brought me earlier is 1 of them.
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP19_TXT: If you're lucky, you'll come across more treasures as you search for Sally.
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP1_TXT: Hey everyone, look at this. What do you think it is?
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP20_TXT: The hidden locations of these treasures are carved into this wall painting, so when you need some, keep an eye out!
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP21_TXT: Treasures, huh? Whatever it is, I hope it compliments my good looks!
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP22_TXT: ... Ooookaaaaay, Sally's counting on us, so let's get out there!
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP2_TXT: Let's take it to Dr. Leonard for him to look at.
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP3_TXT: Doctor! Could you have a look at this?
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP4_TXT: Hm? What have you got for me this time, Moon?
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP5_TXT: Let's see... Ah, this is an ancient treasure.
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP7_TXT: Yes indeedy, there are treasures all over the place containing the power of this world's ancient ones within.
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP8_TXT: Treasures that hold the power of the ancient ones! Pretty cool, right, Brown?
en.TUTORIAL_TREASURE_GET: You've found the legendary hidden treasure!\nCheck the Treasure Menu.

en.UNIT_ELEMENT_OPEN_GUIDE_STEP_1:
There are 5 elements: Water, Fire, Wood, Light, and Dark.
Elements work in relation to each other.
Attack effects can be further increased 
depending on the elemental attributes of your allies and enemies.
(ATK, Hit Rate, and Skill Hit Rate greatly increase)
en.UNIT_ELEMENT_OPEN_GUIDE_STEP_2:
Water is strong against Fire, Fire is strong against Wood, 
and Wood is strong against Water.
Light and Dark elements oppose each other 
and are unrelated to the 3 elements above.

If a Ranger doesn't have an element unlocked, 
you will need to go to the Unlock Element screen 
and collect the necessary materials.
Get Materials from special stages 
and unlock your Rangers' elements!

zh-Hant.ADVENT_BATTLE_TUTORIAL_STEP1: 降臨Ranger會用特殊技能來妨礙Ranger們，\n但使用各個關卡的推薦能力可以\n讓特殊技能變得無效。
zh-Hant.ADVENT_BATTLE_TUTORIAL_STEP2: 帶著擁有推薦能力的Ranger去戰鬥，\n就能更順利地挑戰降臨關卡！\n打倒降臨Ranger來完成挑戰吧！
zh-Hant.ADVENT_LOSE_MESSAGE1: 被降臨Ranger打敗了…\n用持有合適能力的Ranger來編組隊伍，再挑戰一次吧！
zh-Hant.ADVENT_LOSE_POPUP_DESC: 升級後來編組更強的隊伍吧！
zh-Hant.ADVENT_MAIN_BOTTOM_TEXT: 過關後將有機會獲得各關卡的降臨Ranger喔！#確認好降臨關卡的開放日程，並在想要挑戰的降臨關卡開放時進場挑戰吧！#在降臨關卡獲得的降臨Ranger可以當作超進化素材使用。
zh-Hant.ADVENT_RANGER_COLLECT_LOCATION_NONE: 沒有可以獲得這個Ranger的關卡。
zh-Hant.ADVENT_SCHEDULE_TUTORIAL_STEP1: 將想挑戰的降臨關卡日程通知開啟，\n就能配合日程時間收到推播通知喔！
zh-Hant.ADVENT_STAGE_SCHEDULE_ALARM_NOCHANGE: 進行中的關卡無法變更提示設定。
zh-Hant.ADVENT_STAGE_SCHEDULE_BOTTOM_DESC: 將配合玩家選擇的關卡的開放時間發送推播通知。
zh-Hant.ADVENT_STAGE_SCHEDULE_EMPTY: 目前沒有預定推出的降臨關卡。
zh-Hant.ADVENT_STORY_01: 全新降臨關卡登場！\n來挑戰接踵而來的異世界的Ranger！
zh-Hant.ADVENT_STORY_02: 而且借助他們的力量，\n還能進化獲得擁有全新力量的Ranger！\n來把新夥伴與新力量拿到手吧！
zh-Hant.ADVENT_TUTORIAL_STEP1: 透過降臨關卡清單能確認到\n可獲得的降臨Ranger以及他的屬性。
zh-Hant.ADVENT_TUTORIAL_STEP2: 點擊【入場】進入降臨關卡吧！
zh-Hant.ADVENT_TUTORIAL_STEP3: 所有降臨關卡都可以選擇難度。\n選擇的難度越高，\n獲得降臨Ranger的機率也會越高。
zh-Hant.ADVENT_TUTORIAL_STEP4: 在進入關卡前，\n遊戲會顯示有利於挑戰該\n降臨Ranger的推薦能力。
zh-Hant.ADVENT_TUTORIAL_STEP5: 來與設定的Ranger的能力比對一下，\n加油組出最完美的隊伍吧！

zh-Hant.ARENA_STAGE_TIME_OUT_AND_RESET_TO_THE_NE: 此關卡目前已結束。\n遊戲將於新的競技場模式中重設。
zh-Hant.ARENA_TUTORIAL_DESC_01: 關卡一共有10個，每突破一個關卡就會開放下一個關卡。\n（已突破的關卡無法重新再玩。僅能使用紅寶石重設所有的關卡一次。）
zh-Hant.ARENA_TUTORIAL_DESC_02: 依照各關卡的條件來設定隊伍。
zh-Hant.ARENA_TUTORIAL_DESC_03: 選進隊伍的Ranger會按照被安排的順序自動出擊共三次。
zh-Hant.ARENA_TUTORIAL_DESC_04: 存活Ranger的比例越高，獲得的獎勵就越多。
zh-Hant.AROUSAL_ABILITY_TIP_DESC:
當Ranger進化至★9時，便會獲得覺醒能力。
Ranger可從3～5種覺醒能力中獲得隨機1種，
獲得能力後也可使用再次覺醒券進行變更。\n（每種覺醒能力的出現機率皆相同）
zh-Hant.ASK_TRANSFER_DESC: 確定要轉移訪客帳號的遊戲記錄嗎？
zh-Hant.ATTENDANCE_REWARD_MSG: 領取登入遊戲獎勵活動的獎品!\n查看你的禮物盒。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_ARENA_COIN: 競技場寶石只能在競技場中獲得、\n競技場商店內使用
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_BATTLE_GE:
在寶石商店中能購買各種商品。

寶石可透過PVP、公會活動或其他活動獲得。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_BATTLE_GEM:
在寶石商店中能購買各種商品。
寶石可透過PVP、公會活動或其他活動獲得。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_EVENT_BINGO_TICKET_RANDOM: 使用隨機券即可抽中5×5格子內的隨機數字，但有可能抽到已中選過的數字。隨機券可透過任務來獲得。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_EVENT_BINGO_TICKET_SELECT:
使用指定券便可任選1個未抽中的數字欄位來獲得獎勵。
指定券可依數字重複次數來獲得。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_EVENT_LOTTERY_COIN:
可以透過任務等方式獲得心願槌子。僅收集期間內獲得的槌子可用於參加流星活動的抽獎。
活動結束後，剩下的槌子將自動消失。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_EVENT_ROULETTE_COIN: 「輪盤幣」可透過完成任務來獲得，且僅可於活動期間內取得及使用。活動結束後，剩餘的「輪盤幣」將自動消失。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_FRIENDS_POINT:
幫助朋友和接收幫助
即可獲得用來兌換羽毛和抽卡
的友情點數!
立即在朋友上按一下!
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_GACHA_MILEAGE: 可依終極稀有、特殊裝備、精選和稀有扭蛋的紅寶石和扭蛋券使用數量來獲得里程點數。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_GUILD_COIN: 公會金幣是公會可累積的貨幣，且可於貢獻度兌換中心由公會會長和公會副會長用於交換。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_GUILD_CONTRIBUTION_POINT: 貢獻度可由每位公會成員各自累積，且可於貢獻度兌換中心用於交換。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_GUILD_EVENT_MATERIAL:
可透過任務等方式來獲得，在活動交換商店中可用來購買道具。
若未於活動期間內用來購買道具，於活動期間結束後可於雷納德博士研究所的水晶萃取室中用於交換水晶。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_GUILD_RAID_COIN: 公會寶石只能從公會副本中獲得，\n並可於公會商店中使用。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_PVP_COIN: PVP寶石只能在競技場中獲得、\nPVP商店內使用
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_RANDOM_DICE: 此為用於棋盤遊戲的道具，可透過完成任務來獲得，且活動結束後即會自動消失。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_RANGERS_PASS_POINT: 累積Rangers季票點數就能提升季票等級，並可於升級時獲得季票獎勵。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_SPACE_COIN: 此為挑戰宇宙列車所需的列車票券。\n列車票券將隨著時間經過自動補充，賽季結束後將自動消失。
zh-Hant.BALANCE_ABOUT_TALENT_PIECE: 可透過特別途徑獲得。\n可於融合研究所用於合成李奧納德。
zh-Hant.BATTLE_LEVELUP_TIMELINE_SHARE: 發布至LINE動態消息和朋友分享?
zh-Hant.BATTLE_SHOP_REFRESH_ALERT: 是否要重新整理商店清單?
zh-Hant.BATTLE_SHOP_REFRESH_SUCCESS: 商品清單已更新。去看看各種新商品吧！
zh-Hant.BATTLE_SHOP_TIME_OUT_REFRESH_ALERT: 販售時間已到，商品將會被新的商品所取代。
zh-Hant.BEGINNER_BUFF_DAY_TITLE:
同時開放所
有增益效果
zh-Hant.BEGINNER_BUFF_POPUP_NOTI_MSG: 已享有新手福利，可獲得全部的增益效果。新手福利可適用至<#ffe63d>戰鬥大師等級<->。
zh-Hant.BILLING_NOT_ENOUGH_COIN: 金幣不足,\n要移動至商店嗎?

zh-Hant.BINGO_ALL_BINGO_NO_DRAW: 已達成所有賓果，無法再繼續使用了。
zh-Hant.BINGO_DUPLICATED_REWARD: 獲得抽中重複數字的獎勵了！
zh-Hant.BINGO_FIXED_REWARD: 達成賓果並獲得連線獎勵了！
zh-Hant.BINGO_MAIN_LAYER_DESC: 賓果內的獎勵為隨機決定。

達成任務取得抽獎機會
來完成賓果連線！
zh-Hant.BINGO_NEW_REWARD: 獲得抽中新數字的獎勵了！
zh-Hant.BINGO_NOT_ENOUGH_RANDOM_TICKET: 持有的隨機券不足，無法參加抽獎。
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_1: 可透過任務來獲得隨機券。
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_10: 5×5賓果的獎勵為隨機決定，抽獎前無法得知會出現何種獎勵。透過REWARD來事先確認獎勵陣容吧！
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_11: 在活動期間內達成所有賓果來把各種獎勵帶回家吧！
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_2: 獲得的隨機券可透過RANDOM按鈕來使用。
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_3: 點擊按鈕就能從5×5格子內抽中隨機1個數字。
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_4: 此為隨機抽獎，有可能再次抽到已中選過的數字。
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_5: 屆時若觀看廣告再次抽獎
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_6: 來累積數字重複次數，便可透過系統發送的指定券
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_7: 選擇指定數字來獲得獎勵。
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_8: 每連成1線就可以獲得該條連線的獎勵。
zh-Hant.BINGO_TUTORIAL_STEP_9: 每完成1條賓果連線就能獲得累積獎勵。

zh-Hant.POTENTIAL_TIP_DESC:
潛力等級為所有能力值的潛力數字總和。
等級上限的計算方式如下：
500+清單中已收集到的Ranger數+戰鬥大師Ranger數
等級上限為%d。
zh-Hant.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_1: 你來了啊！經過多年的研究，終於讓我找到開發Ranger全新能力的方法了！
zh-Hant.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_2: 現在就讓我來說明潛力的內容，可要聽仔細囉！
zh-Hant.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_3: 只要依照各能力值來使用所需的成長素材，就可以提升潛力等級。當潛力等級提升時，Ranger的能力值就會跟著提升。
zh-Hant.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_4: 點擊升級按鈕來提升潛力等級吧！
zh-Hant.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_5: 清單中收集到的Ranger數越多，潛力等級的上限就會越高。努力收集更多Ranger吧！
zh-Hant.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_6: 提升潛力等級所需的素材可以在主要關卡中獲得。多多挑戰主要關卡吧！
zh-Hant.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_7: 點擊初始化按鈕就可以將Ranger的潛力等級初始化，並取回所使用的素材。
zh-Hant.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_8: 如果不使用初始化道具就進行初始化，將只能取回一部份的素材，要特別注意囉！
zh-Hant.POTENTIAL_UP_POPUP_WARNING: 用於升級的成長素材將會消失。
zh-Hant.PROFILE_ADVENT_DESCRIPTION: Ranger於進行超進化時所需的素材。
zh-Hant.PROFILE_EVOLVE_DESC: 最高等級就是Ranger可以透過進化達到的最高等級。
zh-Hant.PROFILE_EXCEES_LV_DESCRIPTION: MAX級數已經增加了,快升級變得更強吧\n超過次數以「+1 → +2 → +3 → Max」表示
zh-Hant.PROFILE_EXCEES_LV_HOWTO_DESCRIPTION: 升級時，合成「超級李奧納德」或相同的Ranger，便能將 Ranger升級至Max！\n(最多4次)
zh-Hant.PROFILE_EXCEES_LV_HOWTO_DESCRIPTION_FOR_: 升級時，使用「究極李奧納德」或相同類型的「超Ranger」合成便能提高最大級數。\n（最多20次）
zh-Hant.PROFILE_TYPE_AGI_DESC:
「敏捷型」Ranger 會使用爆擊攻擊，
並具備絕佳的物理防禦力和閃避機率。
可以輕易地對強壯的力量型 Ranger 
造成傷害。
zh-Hant.PROFILE_TYPE_INT_DESC:
「智慧型」Ranger 通常會發動範圍攻擊。
因具備魔法攻擊力，
所以善於對戰沒有魔法防禦力的
敏捷型 Ranger。
zh-Hant.PROFILE_TYPE_STR_DESC: 「力量型」 Ranger 不僅擁有高體力，\n也具備魔法防禦力和技能抗性。\n善於對戰以魔法攻擊為主的智慧型 Ranger。
zh-Hant.PVP_BATTLE_CLEAR_DESC: 加入公會後，您就可以在戰鬥中獲得公會守護者的幫助！
zh-Hant.PVP_BLIND_POPUP_TIP: 隨機對戰將無法確認對手的資訊，但獲勝後可以獲得比平常還要更多的獎盃。\n玩家可免費變更隨機對戰的對手，但變更後隨機對戰將會被取消。
zh-Hant.PVP_ELEMENT_SEASON_DESC_FIRE: PVP關卡內會出現給予火屬性Ranger增益效果的區域，若非為火屬性Ranger則會得到負面效果。\n※光或闇屬性的增益效果區域將會隨機出現。
zh-Hant.PVP_ELEMENT_SEASON_DESC_TREE: PVP關卡內會出現給予木屬性Ranger增益效果的區域，若非為木屬性Ranger則會得到負面效果。\n※光或闇屬性的增益效果區域將會隨機出現。
zh-Hant.PVP_ELEMENT_SEASON_DESC_WATER: PVP關卡內會出現給予水屬性Ranger增益效果的區域，若非為水屬性Ranger則會得到負面效果。\n※光或闇屬性的增益效果區域將會隨機出現。
zh-Hant.PVP_GUARDIAN_GET_HELP: 透過公會副本收集召喚石\n就能召喚守護者！
zh-Hant.PVP_HOWTOPLAY_DESC_01: LINE Rangers擁有許多不同的聯盟！\n鍛鍊你的技能，挑戰最厲害的聯盟！
zh-Hant.PVP_HOWTOPLAY_DESC_02: 與各種不同的對手進行一對一的戰鬥！\n你也可以對攻擊者進行復仇！
zh-Hant.PVP_HOWTOPLAY_DESC_03: 您可以自由設定用來抵擋敵軍攻擊的強力防禦隊伍！
zh-Hant.PVP_HOWTOPLAY_DESC_04: 獲得紅寶石與鑽石作為獎勵！\n可以使用商店中的各種商品喔！
zh-Hant.PVP_MAIN_EMPTY_RANKING_LIST: 根據最初3次的PVP作戰結果，分配所屬聯盟。\n在排行榜內將顯示您的個人檔案圖片與名稱。
zh-Hant.PVP_MAIN_POPUP_LEAGUE_INIT_DESC: 組成強力防禦隊伍來阻擋攻擊，\n朝著最高級聯盟邁進！
zh-Hant.PVP_MAIN_POPUP_LEAGUE_INIT_TIP: 您所處的聯盟及擁有的獎盃數，可能會依前一個賽季和最新賽季的成績而有所變動。
zh-Hant.PVP_SELECT_GUARDIAN_DESC: Select a guardian to help you for dangerous moment\n(1 Friend)
zh-Hant.PVP_TUTORIAL_FIRST:
歡迎！
看你來到這邊，想必也想成為最厲害的
特攻隊員吧！我們這邊正在進行
聯盟戰選拔最強隊伍～
zh-Hant.PVP_TUTORIAL_SECOND: 在戰鬥中獲得越多獎盃就能在更高的聯盟\n佔有一席之地，獲得越多的獎勵！！\n來挑戰一下吧！
zh-Hant.RAID_TEAM_CHANGE_CONFIRM: 要將目前的隊伍\n儲存為副本隊伍嗎？
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_1: 透過任務可以收集骰子。
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_10: 其他還有不曉得會發動什麼效果的「？」未知格子。
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_11: 最後還有可以再次擲骰的紅利機會，快來試試自己的手氣吧！
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_12: 依進度也能獲得額外獎勵。
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_13: 多多擲出骰子在活動期間內獲得更多豪華獎勵吧！
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_2: 擲出骰子來獲得棋盤上的各種獎勵吧！
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_3: 棋盤上不只有獎勵格子，還有設置特殊的格子。
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_4: 特殊格子有獎勵2倍、移動N格、移動地圖和太空旅行等等。
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_5: 首先，透過獎勵2倍的格子可以獲得停留格子的2倍獎勵。
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_6: 停在移動N格時，可以依標示數字向前方或後方移動。
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_7: 停在移動地圖格子時，可以隨機移動至獎勵更好的地圖。
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_8: 在獎勵升級的地圖中，只要走完一圈就會回到原本的地圖。
zh-Hant.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_9: 停在太空旅行格子時，可以移動至特殊格子以外的任意獎勵格子來獲得獎勵。

zh-Hant.RSC_DOWNLOAD_DESC:
- 下載指南 -
*在遊玩時可同時進行下載。
*若遊戲發生延遲，請暫停下載。
*剩餘的遊戲資源 可於新手教學結束後下載。
zh-Hant.RSC_DOWNLOAD_FAST_DESC: 更快速體驗遊戲。\n可在下載的同時進行遊戲。下載將優先進行，可能會使遊戲有所延遲。 \n（您可於遊戲中手動暫停下載。）
zh-Hant.RSC_DOWNLOAD_FULL_DESC: 更無縫體驗遊戲。\n先下載完所有遊戲資源後再進行遊戲。
zh-Hant.RSC_DOWNLOAD_NORMAL_DESC: 可在下載的同時進行遊戲。\n以遊戲體驗順暢為優先，可於教學結束後再下載剩餘的遊戲資源。
zh-Hant.RSC_DOWNLOAD_RESTART_CHECK: 為了檢查遊戲資源，遊戲將重新啟動。
zh-Hant.RSC_DOWNLOAD_RESTART_UPDATE: 需要下載新的遊戲資源，將前往遊戲標題畫面。

zh-Hant.SALLY_LAYER_STORY: 辛苦了！但是在宇宙遇到更多危機以前，\n必須趕快和莎莉一起出發去拯救宇宙！

zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_ADVENT: 在降臨關卡中可以獲得超進化所需的Ranger喔！
zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_ARENA: 使用各種不同的Ranger\n來享受競技場戰鬥的樂趣！

zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_GACHA: 你之前也來過了吧？\n這裡是可以獲得強力Ranger和裝備的地方。
zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_GUILD: 要不要加入公會和各式各樣的玩家一起玩啊？
zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_GUILDRAID: 與你的公會成員一起享受\n副本的樂趣！
zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_INTRODUCE: 看來你已經準備好踏上新的冒險了。\n讓我們來看看有那些內容吧！
zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_LAST: 這裡則可以挑戰各式各樣的冒險。首先就去特殊關卡看看吧！
zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_MAIN: 在主要關卡則是要救出莎莉並拯救黃色星球。
zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_MENU: 平時會經常用到的基本選單都在這裡。
zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_PVP: 這裡可以和其他玩家對戰喔！試著挑戰最強聯盟吧！
zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_SPECIALSTAGE: 在特殊關卡中可以獲得特別獎勵。
zh-Hant.SEASON3_HOME_TUTORIAL_UNIT: 在這裡可以確認到和你一同冒險的Ranger們。
zh-Hant.SECOND_TEAM_OPEN_TUTORIAL: 新增隊伍欄！\n以各種不同的方式建立隊伍！\n最後選擇的隊伍會儲存為你的主隊伍。

zh-Hant.SETTING_LINE_LOGIN: 必須與LINE進行連動才能將遊戲資料儲存於您的LINE帳號之中。要前往LINE登入畫面嗎？（若欲連動的LINE帳號中已有遊戲記錄，目前的訪客遊戲資料將被刪除。）
zh-Hant.SETTING_LOGOUT: 要登出嗎？\n登出後將會回到登入畫面。
zh-Hant.SETTING_SENDLOG_DETAIL_CONFIRM: 오류 문의의 신속 대응을 위해 게임로그를 전송하시겠습니까?
zh-Hant.SETTING_SENDLOG_DETAIL_DESC: 게임로그는 단체에서 개인을 식볋할 수 있는 정보는 포함되지 않으며 암호화되어 전송됩니다.
zh-Hant.SETTING_TOHD_MODE: 開啟高畫質模式,若遊戲速度變慢或自行中斷,請關閉此選項,變更將在遊戲重新啟動後生效。

zh-Hant.SKIP_TUTORIAL_SCRIPTS: 要略過目前的新手教學嗎？
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_DESC: 以下效果有助於讓戰鬥力更加提升。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_DARK_DOWN: 闇屬性Ranger在本關卡中體力會稍微減少，\n建議配置闇屬性Ranger以外的Ranger\n來挑戰關卡。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_DARK_UP: 闇屬性Ranger在本關卡中體力會增加，\n建議多多配置闇屬性Ranger\n來挑戰關卡。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_FIRE_DOWN: 火屬性Ranger在本關卡中體力會稍微減少，\n建議配置火屬性Ranger以外的Ranger\n來挑戰關卡。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_FIRE_UP: 火屬性Ranger在本關卡中體力會增加，\n建議多多配置火屬性Ranger\n來挑戰關卡。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_LIGHT_DOWN: 光屬性Ranger在本關卡中體力會稍微減少，\n建議配置光屬性Ranger以外的Ranger\n來挑戰關卡。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_LIGHT_UP: 光屬性Ranger在本關卡中體力會增加，\n建議多多配置光屬性Ranger\n來挑戰關卡。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_TREE_DOWN: 木屬性Ranger在本關卡中體力會稍微減少，\n建議配置木屬性Ranger以外的Ranger\n來挑戰關卡。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_TREE_UP: 木屬性Ranger在本關卡中體力會增加，\n建議多多配置木屬性Ranger\n來挑戰關卡。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_WATER_DOWN: 水屬性Ranger在本關卡中體力會稍微減少，\n建議配置水屬性Ranger以外的Ranger\n來挑戰關卡。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_BUFF_TIP_DESC_WATER_UP: 水屬性Ranger在本關卡中體力會增加，\n建議多多配置水屬性Ranger\n來挑戰關卡。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_DIFFICULY_DESC: 通過的難度越高，透過移動距離\n所獲得的點數也會越多。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_INFO: 取得星星寶箱並前進得更遠就能獲得更高的分數。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_1: 宇宙列車是跑跑類型的戰鬥關卡，進行挑戰時可依移動路線互換適合的Ranger。\n\nRanger的體力將依能力值換算而成的戰鬥力來決定。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_2: 碰到星星寶箱就可以獲得各種獎勵和點數。\n\n透過星星寶箱可依一定機率累積FEVER量表。當FEVER量表全滿時會發動FEVER TIME，使Ranger暫時巨大化並提升能力。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_3: 碰到敵人會受到傷害。碰撞時適當搭配Ranger屬性，可減少Ranger受到的傷害。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_4: 碰到障礙物時會受到大幅傷害，因此要盡量避開喔！
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_5: 如增益踩點和踏上增益踩點的Ranger屬性一致，Ranger將可獲得暫時性的強化。\n道具取得後會立即發動效果。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_EXCEED_ENTRY_ADMISSION: 今天的剩餘入場次數\n已全部用完。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_NONE_PLAY: 目前還沒有玩家挑戰宇宙列車。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_NO_STAGE_PLAY: 尚未挑戰Train%d。\n挑戰宇宙列車，讓車站恢復和平吧！
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_PLAY_REWARD_INFO: 以上獎勵將隨機包含在星星寶箱之中，數量將依難度級別而有所不同。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_POINT_TIP_DESC: 綜合點數是將各列車的最高分加總起來的點數。\n目前的階級將依綜合點數來決定。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_RANKING_NOT_PLAYED: 沒有宇宙列車的挑戰記錄。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_RENT_TIP_DESC: 出租Ranger是僅於1個關卡中可無限次使用的Ranger。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_STARTING_TIP_DESC: 可選擇設定1隻Ranger來作為先發成員。此Ranger可在戰鬥開始後立刻出擊，且無須消耗礦物。先發成員以外的Ranger將隨機登場，且玩家可自行選擇來進行互換。
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_STORY_01: 象徵和平的太空站連結著\n眾多星球和文明，現在卻\n遭到未知的外星人侵略了！
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_STORY_02: 為了拯救陷入危機的太空站，\n坐上宇宙列車打倒外星人\n來拯救陷入黑暗中的車站吧！
zh-Hant.SPACE_TRAIN_UNLOCK_WITH_COST: 要使用[[%d張]]票券\n來開啟列車嗎？
zh-Hant.SPECIAL_ENTRY_ADMISSION_NO_ACCEPT: 已超過每天\n可以入場的次數
zh-Hant.SPECIAL_ENTRY_GET_ITEM_DESC: 你可以在此關卡中贏得這項獎勵。
zh-Hant.SPECIAL_LOSE_POPUP_DESC: 在特殊關卡，先取得中間的塔城以扭轉戰鬥情勢！
zh-Hant.SPECIAL_QUEST_COMPLETE_DESC: 明天再來挑戰下一個任務吧！
zh-Hant.SPECIAL_QUEST_GIFT_COMPLETE_DESC:
竟然能夠完成所有任務，您太厲害了！
接著就試著出動Rangers看看吧！

zh-Hant.SPECIAL_STAGE_STORY_01: 在這顆星球上有很多可以幫助Ranger\n進化的強力進化素材喔！

zh-Hant.SPECIAL_STAGE_TUTORIAL_TXT2: 只要你奪下特殊塔城，它就會協助你作戰。\n所以搶先敵人一步，佔領特殊塔城！\n那麼，準備好要開始了嗎？
